pages.title: Before water appears
pages.text: Two flows meet, and a new source appears. I once took that for granted. Then an Ender Pearl disturbed that instant: no water formed, but a pale blue glimmer remained.$(br2)I call it aether. It belongs to neither water nor fire; the world gives it different forms.

pages.title: 1. Catch that instant
pages.text: Make an Aether Disruptor from copper, glass, stone and an Ender Pearl. Place it below a middle water cell with a source on either side at the same height. Scoop out an existing middle source once.$(br2)As the middle flow tries to become a source, the disruptor catches its aether. Look at the device to check collection.

pages.title: 2. Prepare before extracting
pages.text: Keep a crafting table, copper and glass ready. Use the disruptor with an empty hand to extract a fragment, normally holding 200 aether.$(br2)A fragment fades after about 100 ticks, usually five seconds. Craft a Basic Reservoir before it vanishes, then place the reservoir beside the disruptor.

pages.title: 3. Take a jar with you
pages.text: Use a Basic Mana Container on the reservoir to immerse it. When charged, sneak-use with an empty hand to retrieve it.$(br2)Carry the jar and a wand to cast from its reserves. Early collection is slow, so prepare before leaving. An empty jar cannot create its own aether.

pages.title: 4. Guide it through the workshop
pages.text: Place an emitter beside the reservoir and use the tuner on the emitter, then its destination. Keep the pulse route clear.$(br2)To cross walls, craft a resonator shell, install an Amethyst Shard and place it beside the reservoir. Tune the resonator and then a receiving device to join your first branch.

pages.title: 5. Explore along the branches
pages.text: Place another resonator with an Amethyst Shard beside the path. Tune the home resonator and then this new one. Extend the branches toward a mine or woodland.$(br2)Use a portable receiver on any resonator in the main network. It remembers the whole tree and recharges your carried jars within connected coverage.

pages.title: Preserve the glimmer
pages.text: A Nether Star lets aether form lasting crystals. Its chamber produces permanent material; you may wait for this stage if timed crafting is not for you.$(br2)Distant supply requires a personal anchor. Crystalline material preserves your presence in an Ender Chest, preparing the way toward other worlds.
